_comment: ThreePlayerTicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is.

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, one of A, B or C
_slots.{row}: The board row index of the placed mark
_slots.{col}: The board column index of the placed mark
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII board (do not translate)
_slots.{moves}: The comma-separated list of available move tokens like '[4]' (do not translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Oyo nde Ozali Joueur {player_id} na Tic Tac Toe ya Batu Bato.
Elembo na yo ezali '{symbol}'.
Ozali komima na kutambola elembo na yo kati ya planche ya 5 kwa 5 mpo na kotonga ngumba ya minei.
Ngumba ikoki kozala ya mbala-mbala, ya kati, to ya diagonal.
Tambola kimia na formati '[4]' mpo na kombo cellule 4.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Na lolenge ya kobaluka ezali na ntina te. Salela "[cell]" esika oyo cellule eza 0-{max_cell} .
invalid_move.out_of_range: Motango ya cellule oyo ezali na ntina te: {cell}. Esengeli kozala kati 0 mpe {max_cell} .

game_action.placed: Mokeli {player_id} akeli simba na ye ({symbol}) kwenye seka ({row}, {col}).
